objects.description: [ToddyCat](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1022) can determine is Kaspersky software is running on an endpoint by running `cmd /c wmic process where name="avp.exe"`.(Citation: Kaspersky ToddyCat Check Logs October 2023)
objects.description_fa: [ToddyCat](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1022) می‌تواند با اجرای «cmd /c wmic process where name="avp.exe"` مشخص کند که نرم‌افزار Kaspersky در نقطه پایانی اجرا می‌شود.(Citation: Kaspersky ToddyCat Check Logs October 2023)
